title: DaFont: 637.3K accounts breached
summary: In May 2017, font sharing site DaFont suffered a data breach resulting in the exposure of 637k records. Allegedly due to a SQL injection vulnerability exploited by multiple parties, the exposed data included usernames, email addresses and passwords stored as MD5 without a salt.

title: Bell (2017 breach): 2.2M accounts breached
summary: In May 2017, the Bell telecommunications company in Canada suffered a data breach resulting in the exposure of millions of customer records.
